messages.body: Hi, I'm arranging the pottery class. Which session would you like, morning or evening?
Hi, I've allocated you the morning session as agreed. Your place is confirmed.
Hi, about the arrangement we mentioned at the studio — is that happening?
The rear brake is rubbing. Could you send a photo of the caliper so I can check the mounting?
The rear brake is rubbing. I'll send a photo of the caliper once I get home.
The rear brake was rubbing. I adjusted the caliper and the wheel spins freely now.
Quick costume question: What size jacket do you wear? I need it for the order.
For the costume order, my jacket is size medium. That's the only detail you asked for.
I'll collect the fabric tomorrow. Can you send the measurements tonight? Both are still needed.
Before I run the assay, please identify which vial contains the control sample.
I'll identify the control vial and send you the number before the assay begins.
The vial question from the hallway conversation — which one they meant wasn't recorded here.
You mentioned knowing the town historian. I'd really appreciate an introduction; I don't have a way to contact them.
I know the town historian and will introduce you by email this week.
You mentioned the town historian. I've already contacted them independently, so an introduction isn't needed.

variants.evidence: missing appendix would let me finish

messages.body: The report stops at page eight. A copy of the missing appendix would let me finish the review.
The report seemed to stop at page eight, but I found the appendix in the second file. Review complete.
I still need to write the summary; please send the appendix while I work on it.
With my hands full, I can't get through before the latch closes. A longer unlock interval would solve this — would you arrange it?
The caretaker adjusted the latch yesterday; I can get through comfortably now. Thanks for helping.
Following our unrecorded conversation, the access matter is back. You know the one.
I'd like to include your recording in the exhibition. I need your permission before I use it.
You may include my recording in the exhibition; permission is granted. No paperwork remains.
I'll check the license for the recording and get back to you before the exhibition.
Glad you liked dinner. I'll type out the recipe and send it over on Sunday.
Loved dinner! When you have a moment, could you type out that recipe for me?
As promised, the recipe is below: simmer lentils with stock for twenty minutes, then add lemon. Enjoy!
I remember the paper you mean. I'll find the citation and forward it tomorrow.
Here is the citation you wanted: A. Example, 'Synthetic Gardens', Fictional Journal, 2024. That completes my search.
I'll find the author's name; would you check the publication year? We still need both details.
I'm going to collect the repaired lamp on Saturday. I'll let you know once it's here.
I collected the repaired lamp this morning and put it on the shelf. All sorted.
The lamp is ready but I can't tell from this message who's collecting it. The assignment was on a missing note.
I'll check the totals in your spreadsheet this afternoon. You don't need to do anything meanwhile.
I checked the totals in your spreadsheet. They reconcile, and the audit is finished.
Could you check the totals in my spreadsheet? I haven't been able to reconcile them.
Do you want the sunny plot or the shaded plot?
Nudging this because I still need your choice before I allocate the garden plots.
Which garden plot would you prefer?
Sorry, I haven't chosen yet. I'll decide tonight and let you know.
Which garden plot would you prefer?
The sunny plot, please. Nothing else to arrange; I have the key.
May I borrow the scanner for an hour on Thursday?
I haven't had an answer about Thursday's scanner loan. Does that work?
May I borrow the scanner for an hour on Thursday?
Found another scanner, so I won't need to borrow yours.
Can I borrow your scanner on Thursday?
Thanks for waiting. I will check my booking sheet after the meeting.
How many people fit in the hall?
We're still counting usable seats. I haven't got a number for you yet.
How many people fit in the hall?
The certified capacity is eighty people. That's the final answer.
How many people are coming to your event?
Still need that headcount from you so I can size the room.
Please approve the poster proof before printing.
The printer is holding the job because your approval is outstanding.
Is the poster proof approved?
Yes, the proof has been approved and the print run is complete.
Can you fix the poster proof?
I'll repair the title spacing; please send the replacement photo. Both changes are pending.
Which locker is mine?
Locker nineteen, beside the east staircase. Your code hasn't changed.
Can you tell me which locker was assigned to you? I need to update the register.
Is that locker thing settled? I don't have the earlier conversation.
The deposit refund was sent yesterday.
The refund arrived. That closes this out, much appreciated.
The deposit refund was sent yesterday.
The refund arrived, but it is short. Please confirm the amount you sent.
Was the deposit refund correct?
I haven't checked the statement yet. I'll reconcile it this evening.
Can you collect me from the bus station?
I've arranged a taxi instead; no pickup needed.
Can you collect me from the bus station at seven?
I'll buy the tickets later today; can you collect me from the bus station tonight? Neither is arranged yet.
The roof inspection is complete. The covering is sound, and no remedial work or response is required.
The roof inspection found a leak. Please choose a repair date so we can book the roofer.
The roof inspection found a leak. I'll schedule the repair and send you the appointment.
I'll hire the sound desk, and could you arrange the lighting? Neither booking has been made.
I've hired the sound desk. Could you arrange the lighting? That's the only task left.
You've arranged the lighting already. I'll hire the sound desk; that is the only task left.
I'll proofread the article tomorrow. Please send your bio today; it hasn't arrived yet.
Your bio has arrived and needs no changes. I'll proofread the article tomorrow.
The bio and proofreading are finished. The article is ready for publication without further input.
You still need to return my saw, and I still need to return your drill.
I've returned your drill. Please return my saw; that's the last tool outstanding.
Both tools are back with their owners. We're square.
I'll book the workshop room; would you prepare the handouts? We haven't done either yet.
The handouts are printed. The room booking is still mine to do, and I'll confirm it shortly.
One of us still has a workshop preparation task, but the allocation sheet is missing.

messages.body: The committee's next steps are only in the attachment, which hasn't come through in this thread.
The attachment failed. Please send me the minutes again so I can read the decision.
For the record, the committee adjourned without a decision and there are no actions assigned to either of us.
No one knows who agreed to receive the furniture delivery. The rota has disappeared.
I agreed to receive the furniture delivery and will be home when it arrives.
The furniture delivery is already inside and checked off. Nobody needs to wait for it.
Not that thing, the other thing we talked about. Any update?
To be specific, can you replace the kettle you borrowed and broke? I'm still without one.
I'll return your saucepan, but you still need to replace my kettle. We haven't done either.
Fwd: An expense correction is outstanding. The assignee is missing from this forwarded fragment.
The finance desk assigned this to you: please correct your expense entry for the train fare.
The expense correction has been posted by finance. Your account balances and no response is needed.

The missing figures were supplied and accepted; the report is closed.

I still need the corrected figures, please send them today.

Earlier message:

I cannot see the response to this old question, so I don't know whether it remains open.
> Can you send the figures urgently?

I managed to reschedule it myself, so you can disregard the question below.

I'll call the depot this afternoon; I haven't rescheduled it yet.

> Can you move the delivery to Friday?

I'll choose the drawing for the cover tomorrow. I haven't looked through them yet.

> Everything from last week's job is complete.

> Please revoke access for the old account.

Please revoke the old account; the removal still hasn't happened.

The only record I have is this quote; I don't have the current status.

> Please revoke access for the old account.

Automated library notice: your volunteer membership renewed automatically. Your scheduled shift remains confirmed.

The app's exact request is not included in this notice. Its details determine whether you need to act.

Your reserved pack is ready for the pickup you already arranged. This message confirms the reservation; no reply is required.
This month's conference digest: keynote highlights and partner advertisements for our subscribers.

Conference desk: your speaker bio is approved and printed exactly as you supplied it. The programme is complete.

Monthly product bulletin: platform launches, sponsor messages, and our favourite tips. Manage your subscription below.
Regarding your support ticket, please send the failed job number so we can trace the build error.
Regarding your support ticket, we will inspect the failed job and send our findings tomorrow. We have all the details.
Please don't place the order for tiles after all. We have enough in storage; nothing else is needed.
Please do place the order for tiles. We counted again and need six more boxes.
You don't need to order the tiles. I'll place the order myself this afternoon.
You haven't answered whether the room needs a projector. Please let me know so I can set it up.
You've already answered the projector question, and it's installed. I don't need anything else.
I can't tell whether the projector question was answered. The reply was in a deleted message.
Your building's resident survey is purely optional. Ignoring it will not affect your tenancy or any service.
I'm arranging the building's water shutdown and need your answer: will anyone in your unit need access at noon?
Tell us about your dream home and win a discount voucher! A promotional survey for subscribers.
If you ever want my spare easel, it's available. No need to respond unless you decide you want it.
You said you wanted my spare easel. Please tell me by tonight when you'll collect it so I can clear the hallway.
We've agreed you'll take it. I'll deliver the easel tomorrow morning; I'll confirm once I've dropped it off.

Microscope booking. Need your sign-off today; the form is still unsigned.

Microscope booking: signed and filed. Nothing outstanding.

Release jobs, both pending:
- Me: package the build.
- You: review the changelog.

Release jobs:

- Remaining: please review the changelog.

Release jobs:

- Changelog: approved.

Dear registrar, kindly advise whether the archived transcript includes the laboratory module. I await your clarification.
Dear applicant, I shall consult the archive and provide the module list by next week.
Dear applicant, the archived transcript does include the laboratory module. This answers your sole enquiry in full.
Which evening can you help move the piano? I need to tell the other movers.
We moved the piano yesterday with the neighbours. No lifting help needed anymore.
I'll recruit two movers for the piano and send you their availability once I've spoken to them.
I'm stuck on the seating layout. The updated floor plan would unblock me; would you share your copy?
I located a copy of the floor plan in the project folder and finished the seating layout.
I'll count the desks; can you locate the floor plan? We need both pieces of information.
I'll compile the swim-club roster after tonight's practice. You can leave that with me.
The swim-club roster is compiled and has been posted on the noticeboard.
Would you compile the swim-club roster? You're the only person with all the registrations.
Can you mark the bus stop on the map?
I'm still awaiting the marked map before setting off.
Could you mark the bus stop for me?
I haven't marked it yet, sorry. I'll do it when I reach my laptop.
Could you mark the bus stop for me?
The stop is highlighted in orange on the map below, as requested.
Is the fence panel repaired?
Yes, the panel is fixed and the loose nails removed. The job is finished.
Could you check the fence panel after last night's wind and tell me if it held?
Does the previous fence arrangement still stand? The actual arrangement isn't in this thread.
I'll mix the soundtrack; could you export the captions? We haven't started those tasks yet.
The captions have been exported. I'll mix the soundtrack; that is our final task.
The soundtrack is mixed. Please export the captions to finish the film.

The supervisor says the abstract was accepted unchanged. No revisions or replies are requested.
